issues.t: Transmission failure or torque converter clutch fault
issues.sym: A "Service Transmission" or check engine light, grinding or rough shifts, slipping, and in bad cases a burning smell or a car that barely moves.
issues.why: The 9-speed automatic can wear internally, and the torque converter clutch is a known trouble spot. Fiat has issued a bushing repair kit for the torque converter clutch code (P1DB7) on later cars, and one 2016 owner needed a full transmission after metal was found in it.
issues.next: Stop driving hard and have the transmission codes read soon. Ask a Fiat or Chrysler dealer to check for software updates and service bulletins before agreeing to a replacement.

issues.t: 2.4L engine burns oil (warranty extension)
issues.sym: The oil level drops between changes with no drips under the car and no smoke. In bad cases the low oil pressure light comes on.
issues.why: Some 2.4L Tigershark engines use far more oil than normal. Fiat ran oil-use inspections and later extended the warranty on this engine for excess oil use.
issues.next: Check the dipstick every couple of fill-ups and top up as needed. Ask a dealer for an oil consumption test and whether the extended warranty covers your VIN. Running low on oil can ruin the engine.

issues.t: 9-speed automatic shifts harshly, lags or shudders
issues.sym: Jerky or hard shifts (often 2nd to 3rd), a pause before the car picks up speed from a stop, shudder, or the check engine light.
issues.why: The 9-speed automatic relies heavily on software. Fiat released several transmission computer updates for shift quality, slow 1-2 upshifts and shudder.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check for transmission software updates and run the quick-learn procedure. If it slips or flashes a warning, have it checked before it gets worse.

issues.t: Transmission may shift to neutral without warning (recall)
issues.sym: The car can suddenly lose drive while moving, as if put in neutral.
issues.why: Poor wire crimps in the transmission sensor wiring could make the 9-speed shift to neutral on its own.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Dealers reprogram the engine and transmission computers and replace the wiring if needed, free.

issues.t: Radiator cooling fan fails and engine overheats (notice V54)
issues.sym: Temperature gauge rising in traffic, a check engine light, or warning messages; the fan may not run.
issues.why: Fiat issued a customer satisfaction notice (V54) to repair the engine cooling fan on these cars.
issues.next: If the gauge climbs, pull over and shut the engine off. Ask a dealer whether notice V54 is open on your VIN.

issues.t: Engine oil leaks from valve cover and seals
issues.sym: Oil spots under the car, a burning oil smell after driving, or oil on the engine.
issues.why: Fiat issued a bulletin for oil leak and oil use complaints on this model, and owners report valve cover gasket leaks.
issues.next: Check the oil level and have the leak traced with dye before replacing parts. Oil dripping on a hot exhaust can smoke.

issues.t: Start-stop or battery charging warnings
issues.sym: A battery or charging light, start-stop not working, or battery messages even though the car starts.
issues.why: The battery sensor that tells the car how charged the battery is can read wrong. Fiat has a bulletin for wrong state-of-charge readings and related codes.
issues.next: Have the battery and charging system tested. A weak battery is common, but ask about the battery sensor bulletin before buying parts.

issues.t: Dead battery and frequent jump starts
issues.sym: The car won't start after sitting, sometimes even after the battery tests good, so you need jump starts often.
issues.why: Fiat has a bulletin on battery drain after the key is off, including lights or modules staying awake too long.
issues.next: Have a shop do a parasitic draw test and a battery test. Keep jumper cables or a jump pack until it is fixed.

issues.t: Turbo engine surges or sets underboost code P0299
issues.sym: The engine surges or feels uneven when cruising, sometimes with a check engine light.
issues.why: Fiat issued a bulletin for engine surge and turbo underboost codes after an engine computer update on these turbo engines.
issues.next: Have the codes read. A dealer can apply the fix from the bulletin. Avoid hard acceleration until it is checked.

issues.t: Airbag warning light on
issues.sym: The airbag light stays on or comes on now and then.
issues.why: Fiat issued a bulletin for airbag warning light problems on this model. Wiring connectors are a common cause.
issues.next: Have the airbag codes read soon. Airbags may not work right while the light is on.

issues.t: Seat belt buckle sensor may stop the front airbag (recall)
issues.sym: You may see no warning, or an airbag light.
issues.why: A seat belt buckle sensor may not be connected properly, so a front airbag may not deploy as designed.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Dealers repair the connection for free.

issues.t: Airbag computer software may disable safety systems (recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning you would notice.
issues.why: Wrong software in the airbag computer could turn off some crash safety features.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Dealers update the software for free.

issues.t: Engine computer chip can fail and stall the car (recall)
issues.sym: The engine may stall while driving or not start.
issues.why: A voltage regulator chip inside the engine computer could fail.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Dealers replace the engine computer for free.

issues.t: Rear brake caliper may be cracked (recall)
issues.sym: Brakes may feel weaker or uneven, or you may see brake fluid near the right rear wheel.
issues.why: The right rear brake caliper may have cracked when it was cast.
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls. Dealers inspect and replace the caliper for free.

issues.t: Tire pressure warning may not light (recall)
issues.sym: The tire pressure light may stay off even when a tire is low.
issues.why: An instrument panel software error kept the tire pressure warning from coming on.
issues.next: Check tire pressures by hand until it is fixed, and check your VIN for open recalls. Dealers update the software for free.

issues.t: A/C stops blowing cold
issues.sym: The A/C blows warm or only slightly cool air.
issues.why: Owners report A/C failures, and Fiat has a bulletin for systems found low on refrigerant with no leak found. A failed compressor is the costly case.
issues.next: Have the A/C pressures checked and leak-tested. Ask about the bulletin before agreeing to a compressor.

issues.t: Check engine light for small EVAP leak (P0456)
issues.sym: Check engine light with no change in how the car drives.
issues.why: A small leak in the fuel vapor system sets this code. Fiat has a special test for finding these leaks.
issues.next: Make sure the gas cap clicks tight. If the light stays on, have the vapor system smoke-tested.

issues.t: Cranks but won't start in freezing weather (muffler TSB)
issues.sym: On very cold mornings the engine cranks but won't start or starts poorly.
issues.why: Water can collect and freeze inside a muffler that has no drain hole, blocking the exhaust.
issues.next: Ask a dealer about the bulletin. The fix is drilling a small drain hole in the muffler.

issues.t: Misfire from ignition coil boots
issues.sym: Rough running, shaking at idle, or a flashing check engine light.
issues.why: Fiat has a bulletin to replace all four ignition coil boots on the 2.4L engine.
issues.next: If the check engine light flashes, pull over when it's safe and turn the engine off. Have the misfire codes read and ask about the coil boot bulletin.

issues.t: Uconnect, CarPlay or Bluetooth problems
issues.sym: Apple CarPlay or Android Auto won't connect, freezes or drops; Bluetooth or navigation errors; apps missing from the screen.
issues.why: Fiat released several radio software updates. Cheap or worn USB cables also cause many connection problems.
issues.next: Try a different factory-quality cable first. Then ask a dealer for radio software updates.

issues.t: False "low beam out" message
issues.sym: The dash says a low-beam headlight is out, but both headlights work.
issues.why: A body computer software problem can show a false bulb-out message.
issues.next: Check both headlights. If they work, ask a dealer for the body computer update.

issues.t: Electronic parking brake won't set or key sticks
issues.sym: The parking brake may not engage, with a warning light, and the key may stick in the ignition.
issues.why: Fiat issued ABS computer software updates for the electronic parking brake on early cars.
issues.next: Use Park and chock a wheel on hills until fixed. Ask a dealer for the ABS software update.

issues.t: Front brakes squeal
issues.sym: A squeal or squeak from the front brakes when slowing down.
issues.why: Fiat has a bulletin for cleaning sealant from the caliper brackets and, if needed, fitting new pads and hardware.
issues.next: Have the brakes inspected so wear is ruled out, then ask about the bulletin fix.

issues.t: Water on passenger floor from A/C drain tube
issues.sym: A wet carpet on the front passenger side, often after using the A/C.
issues.why: The A/C condensation drain tube can come loose from the heater box, so water drips inside.
issues.next: Dry the carpet to prevent mold and have the drain tube secured.

issues.t: Check engine light from false fault codes
issues.sym: Check engine light on with no change in how the car drives.
issues.why: Fiat has issued a service alert for check engine lights caused by fault codes that are not real faults.
issues.next: Have the codes read. Ask a dealer about software updates before replacing parts.

issues.t: Transmission fluid leak at case seam or axle seal
issues.sym: Reddish fluid drips under the front of the car.
issues.why: Fiat has bulletins for leaks at the transmission case split line and at the axle stub shaft.
issues.next: Have the leak found and fixed soon; low fluid can damage the transmission.

issues.t: False blind spot or parking sensor warnings
issues.sym: Blind spot or parking sensors beep or warn when nothing is there.
issues.why: Fiat has a bulletin for false warnings from these driver-assist sensors.
issues.next: Clean the sensors and bumper corners. If it continues, have a dealer check them.
